<thought>Since searching the template catalog with specific functional group criteria returned no results, the most direct way to obtain the precursors is to apply the known retrosynthetic template for Friedel‑Crafts acylation directly. The template ID for this transformation in the database is “template_1001”. Using this template with the target molecule SMILES will generate the possible precursor pairs (aryl halide and acyl chloride).</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CNc1c(C(=O)Nc2cccc(OC)c2)nnn1Cc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1",
    "template_id": "template_1001"
}
